caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, metal tin container with a faded and worn decorative design. The tin is predominantly green with areas of rust and wear revealing the metal underneath. Around the body of the tin, there is an illustration of a neoclassical building with tall columns and detailed architectural features, rendered in colors such as red, white, and light green. The top of the tin also features parts of the building’s depiction with similar color tones. The lower section of the tin is adorned with a crisscross, diamond-like pattern in muted shades of red, white, and green. Faint, partially visible text runs along the upper area of the tin, with some letters discernible, like "EXC" and "MERCHANTS." The background of the image is plain and off-white, and there are no objects present besides the tin itself.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
